description: Pattern-similarity values equal to 0.439 pass the filter (at least 0.439).

a.request: Take the advanced behaviour records with a similarity to illicit patterns (`patsim`) of at least 0.439 and match each one to its transaction record(s), where `transactionrecord.transreg` equals `advancedbehavior.translink`; drop records with no match. For each order type mix (`ordertypedist`), treating a missing mix as its own group, show the order type mix and the number of matched records.
a.sql: SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY tr.ordertypedist

d.request: Filter advancedbehavior records to those with patsim >= 0.439, inner join to transactionrecord where transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink, group by ordertypedist (treating NULL as a distinct group), and count transactionrecords in each group.
d.sql: SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist

c.request: Using 0.439 as the cutoff for similarity to illicit patterns (`patsim`), take the advanced behaviour records with high similarity and match each one to its transaction record(s), where `transactionrecord.transreg` equals `advancedbehavior.translink`; drop records with no match. For each order type mix (`ordertypedist`), treating a missing mix as its own group, show the order type mix and the number of matched records. Pattern-similarity values equal to 0.439 pass the filter (at least 0.439).
c.sql: SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records_count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY tr.ordertypedist

b.request: Filter advancedbehavior records where patsim >= 0.439, match each to transactionrecord records where transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink, exclude unmatched advancedbehavior records, group by ordertypedist treating NULL as a distinct group, and count the number of matched records per group.
b.sql: SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
